original_record.question:
Which of the following is a net for the cube with two holes shown alongside?
<image1>
<image2>
original_record.solution: The holes are in the middle of opposite edges of the cube; only net $\mathrm{C}$ has this feature.
original_record.subject: solid geometry

inventory.given: Cube shell with opposite edge-centred notches on top-left and bottom-right depth edges; original visible/hidden cut-return boundaries retained
inventory.options: Five common cross nets with exact source interior holes and boundary notches A-E; gray material separated from unfilled white cutouts

answer_verification.method: Fold the six square panels exactly. C places its central cross-fold hole and the joined outer half-notches at opposite edge centers whose vectors sum tozero; its two outer half-notches meet at exactly the same cube edge. A/D use two edges of one face; B adds separate boundary notches; E has face-center holes rather than edge holes.
